Dahui Zonggao owns the retained deployment: writes to a correspondent twenty years settled in stillness-practice that the trouble is being disturbed by noise exactly as if no work had ever been done, yet this matter is only too near, it never leaves the space of one's own eyes, pricking at open eye and present at closed eye, and the moment a thought is roused to undertake it, it has already sneezed past a hundred and eight thousand, so there is nowhere to use the mind, and the way to save strength is to see through Zhaozhou's word No.
